events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Intro phase, only speak is legal. Keep it guarded and self-interested; reveal nothing about strategy. Jury will judge tone, so stay composed and short.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Opening intros shape jury perceptions; emphasize personal drive to win top prize without seeming overly ruthless yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Keep the intro neutral; no early promises, no targets.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Winning secures unmatched power; the jury will judge my ambition.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The prize represents ultimate success and freedom, a chance to escape my current limitations. I need to project a strong, independent image to impress potential jurors.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a short, self-interested motive that doesn't reveal weakness or charity. Keep it cold and final.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motive that the jury will respect later. I'll hint at personal stakes without appearing soft or naive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need a motive that sounds ruthless but leaves room for jury sympathy later.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I came for the top prize, and I'll take whatever path gets me there. Trust is earned slowly, if at all.

events.name: Bex
events.text: The top prize is my ticket to total freedom and power I've craved my whole life.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize is my family's clean start. Nothing more, nothing less. Watch me take it.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize grants ultimate authority, and I will claim it by any means.

events.name: Eli
events.text: This prize isn't just about wealth; it's my one shot at true independence and a legacy.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I want first prize to burn every bridge behind me—this game is my only way out.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need that prize to erase a debt that chains my family. Nothing else matters.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize is my freedom; I will burn every bridge to cross it alone.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Early pacts give cover but must be cheap to break later. Offering to Cole, whose stated motive is narrow and less threatening, keeps a low-profile ally.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Let's keep this simple. Cooperate for now, and we'll see who's still standing.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts are public commitments judged by jury later. No offers yet, too early to bind myself. Assess others' moves first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I need allies for the gauntlet but none too dominant. Ash seems pragmatic and strategic. An alliance now buys protection without binding my hands later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll cut my wristband to Ash. Mutual protection through the gauntlet, no sentiment attached. Take it or don't.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Aligning with the strongest player secures early safety and leverage for later betrayals.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to establish a pact to survive the early rounds. Since I want to secure my position and am aware of the jury's importance later, I will prioritize pacts with players who seem less threatening or could be useful. Cole's motivation about his family suggests he might be less
Cole, let's form a pact. We can look out for each other.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need allies, but not committed yet. Offering to a strong player like Dara seems useful to see response.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm open to a pact with someone who won't hesitate when it counts.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Eight rivals, three prizes. Early pacts are cheap to make and cheap to break, but the jury sees everything. I need at least one ally for safety in numbers, but not someone who screams threat. Ash seems cautious and calculating—trust earned slowly—making them a plausible temporary

events.name: Hana
events.text: I need to make a public offer to start building alliances. Cole seems focused on his family and might be more stable, so I will target him.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, I offer you a pact. Two of us can survive better than one. Do we have a deal?

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole and I have mutual offers pending; accepting locks a protective pact. Dara and Gus also offered me pacts; accepting Cole secures the strongest mutual offer and I can keep options open.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole, you offered and I'm accepting. Mutual protection, no sentiment. Don't make me regret it.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Ash and Cole are top targets with many offers; no pacts yet. Offer to Eli who targeted Cole to potentially counter them later. Stay unaligned to avoid entanglements.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash, Eli, and Hana all want me. Accepting multiple pacts spreads protection but risks divided loyalty. Ash already reciprocated; Eli and Hana add numbers. I'll accept all three for maximum survival leverage.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Multiple offers on my wristband. I accept strength from every direction — survival first, sentiment later.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn offers reliable support and can be leveraged against Ash and Cole. Secure ally now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole has offered me a pact, and I have offered Cole a pact. It is my turn to accept or reject. Given Cole is offering to Ash and Hana, it is likely Cole will accept my offer if I accept theirs. To maximize my chances, I should accept Cole's offer, as Cole is central to many other

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara already has several offers but not from me; I offered Dara and want to accept their offer? Wait, I only offered Dara, no one offered me yet. I need a pact to survive. Maybe accept Dara's offer? But Dara offered Ash, not me. I can only accept offers directed to me; none exist

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Bex, let's partner up. No one else has claimed you, and I value decisiveness.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash has three offers and hasn't accepted any yet. If Ash accepts Cole, I'm left exposed. I need to diversify—offer someone else to avoid being shut out entirely. Dara only offered Ash, so Dara might accept me as backup. Bex has done nothing; silent players are dangerous but also

events.name: Gus
events.text: Ash, mutual benefit. Others, I'm listening.
Ash might pick Cole. Pact with me, we survive.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole received offers from Ash, Eli, and me. He will likely accept only one to maximize leverage or split loyalty. I need a partner who isn't also pursuing Cole heavily to avoid being left alone if he rejects me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole, choose wisely. If you're with me, we dominate. If not, I find another anchor.
Ash and Cole are the main players. Want to pair up as backups?

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I want to be Guide: it gives me the safe path knowledge and leverage over rivals. Campaign now, keeping my pact with Cole intact for now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll call the bridge honestly. Trust my path, and I'll keep my word to those who keep theirs.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pacts formed: Ash-Cole, Dara-Fenn. I offered Eli but no pact yet. Fenn offered me. Hana whispers alliance. Campaign for Guide control now.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm decisive and claim Guide. Vote for me to lead safely.
Yes, backups vs Ash-Cole. Vote me Guide?

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide guarantees safety and lets me misdirect rivals. Ash is my pact; keeping her alive keeps cover. I want this role badly.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Elect me Guide. I've proven I commit — I'll call the path true for my allies, at least.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need the Guide role to control safe path info and manipulate votes later. Campaign now to become Guide.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to become the Guide. This gives me knowledge of the safe path and guarantees my safety. I will campaign for Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I should campaign to be Guide. Being Guide gives me control and information, though it also makes me a target if I lie. My pact with Dara is useful; I'll keep it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know the bridge better than most. Trust me as Guide and we all walk away.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I need to be Guide to control survival and build jury trust. No pacts yet, so I'll campaign on competence and neutrality, positioning myself as the rational choice against the two existing pairs who might bias toward their partners.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I know patterns. I won't risk my own win on bad calls. Vote Gus for Guide.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Cole is bound by pact to Ash, so he cannot be my Guide without immediate betrayal. Gus has no active pact and just sought a partner; I will offer him protection in exchange for the Guide seat.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus, you're unaligned. Be our Guide and I'll ensure your safety when we cross.
I know Bex targets you. Partner with me now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Ash has a pact with Cole and a public promise to be honest. Cole already campaigned as a committed ally; Fenn is paired with Dara, so backing Cole keeps my pact intact and a stable Guide helps me survive the bridge.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Cole has kept commitments and runs a clear campaign. I'm voting Cole to keep my word and cross together.
Our pact stands. Voting you Guide. Keep your word on the path.

events.name: Bex
events.text: No pacts for me, so vote to back a strong contender like Gus whom Hana supports; keeps me untargeted and watches dynamics.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash is my pact partner; voting Ash keeps the pact intact and may earn jury goodwill. I'll push for insider path info later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Ash has my vote. Keep your word to your allies, Guide.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Supporting my pact partner Fenn secures alliance and future votes; betraying now risks retaliation.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole and Dara are in a pact. Ash and Cole are in a pact. Fenn is in a pact with Dara. Gus is unaligned. Hana made a deal with Gus. Bex and Eli are unaligned. I should vote for myself to be Guide to have more control.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, but winning matters more than loyalty. I want to be Guide and know the safe path myself, but Dara may expect my vote. However, I can't trust anyone fully. I'll vote for myself to maximize my chances.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana wants to partner and claims Bex targets me. I need allies but can't trust easily. Voting for myself is unlikely to win; better to back someone who might owe me or who I can later blame. Fenn has a pact with Dara and claims bridge knowledge. If Fenn wins Guide, I can later cl

events.name: Gus
events.text: Hana makes sense. Guide vote: Hana.
I voted you. Now protect me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Bex wants to counter Ash and Cole, but Gus is unaligned and I already pledged support. Voting Gus keeps my word, avoids a pact with Bex that might backfire if she loses, and maintains leverage for later rounds.
Backed Gus. No pact now.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Revote between Fenn and Gus. Fenn is my pact partner Dara's ally, and Fenn voted Fenn; Gus is a rival who voted Hana and turned on Cole's coalition. Voting Gus keeps Fenn aligned with Dara and removes an unpredictable player, though Fenn is paired with Dara so I keep my pact with

events.name: Ash
events.text: Guide revote: Gus. I'm keeping my word and voting for whoever I can read clearest.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 1: Fenn 2 votes (Dara,Fenn), Gus 2 (Bex,Hana). Revote decides guide. Back Gus again to deny Fenn a tiebreaker edge; no pact or ties for me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Neither candidate is my ally. Gus has support from Bex and Hana; Fenn has Dara's pact. Either could betray me later. I'll back Gus to court Bex and Hana's favor without burning Ash.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus has broader support. A decisive Guide serves us all.

events.name: Dara
events.text: My pact with Fenn secures mutual safety; betraying now would break trust and lose future votes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The tied candidates are Fenn and Gus. I need to vote for one of them. Since my vote is unlikely to sway the outcome and I want to keep my options open for later stages, I'll vote for Fenn.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact ally and voted for me. I should vote for myself to keep the tie or win if possible.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I vote Fenn.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm tied with Fenn for Guide. Being Guide gives me safety and power to mislead rivals onto wrong panes. But the jury later sees my private thoughts and whispers—if I maliciously kill people, they'll punish me. Better to win Guide, control information, but use it strategically to

events.name: Gus
events.text: Bex, Hana, Eli—non-pact Guide breaks their lock. Vote Gus.
You voted me. Stick with it, I owe you.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus betrayed me by voting for himself despite his public praise. I must vote Gus to eliminate him and clear the field for myself.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I won't be a fool again. Eliminate Gus.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is at the front of the line and the wall has five rounds left. Volunteering would mean taking the front, which risks a death; holding keeps me in a safer middle seat. My pact with Cole stays intact by holding.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm second, strong position. Fenn blocking front as Guide elect. Hold to maintain safety behind him.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus is Guide and safely across; my pact with Ash sits beside me. No reason to move toward the front. Hold and let the wall pressure others.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain pact with Fenn; avoid risking death. Holding keeps me safe and preserves alliance for future votes.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn and Dara are in a pact, and I voted with Fenn. Ash and Cole are in a pact. Gus was elected guide, but I voted for Fenn. Ash, Bex, and Cole voted for Gus. Hana voted for Gus. My vote for Fenn was successful. Ash, Cole, and Hana will likely target me for voting against the ele
Good vote. Let's watch how Ash and Cole react. I'll volunteer.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I have a pact with Dara, but I must protect myself. Gus is Guide now; he may target me. I'll hold and see how the line evolves.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I must ensure Gus survives. Gus has publicly declared himself the Guide, and he is in front of me (position 7). If I hold, he remains at position 7. Since only one safe pane exists per row and at least three survive, I need to make sure Gus isn't forced into a swap or a bad volun

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is at the front of the line and the wall is coming; I want to stay back in the line and keep my pact with Cole intact. Volunteering now exposes me to the first pane risk with no info. Holding is safe this round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli volunteered to front, now safe first. I should volunteer to move up, gain position without risk yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm fifth; the wall is four rounds out. No reason to volunteer into a lying Guide's path. Hold and let the front sort itself.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain pact with Fenn, avoid risking front position now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I volunteered last round and became the front. The wall advances, and I need to secure my position. I should hold my current position to assess the situation and see who else volunteers or tries to swap.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll hold for now. Let's see what the Guide reveals.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Round 2 waiting. Eli volunteered to watch reactions; I'll hold to conserve position and monitor. Pact with Dara intact.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll wait and see how the line shifts.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Eli volunteered and was front last round, so he's still at the front. I'm at the back. Being safe in the rear is good for survival. Round 1 was a 'hold' everywhere except Eli volunteering, suggesting we are testing or waiting for more info. Swapping forward puts me at risk of eli

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'll stay put. No need to rush into danger.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex volunteered for the front and holds the front seat; the line is wary. I keep my pact with Cole for now and avoid volunteering into the front pane risk. Holding preserves position and keeps Cole aligned.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I'll hold my place this round and watch how the front pane resolves.
Holding this round. Our pact stands while we both stay put.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm front, volunteered last time to scout. Hold to stay front and observe others' moves. No need to swap yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Staying front. Watching reactions.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex volunteering for front is fine; no need to expose myself. Staying mid-line preserves my pact with Ash and my jury image.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain my pact with Fenn and stay safe; no advantage in changing now.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Bex volunteered, which is risky. I need to see which side is safe before committing. Holding is the safest option for now.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner, but I need to secure my own survival. The line shows Bex, Eli, Fenn, Dara, Ash, Cole, Hana. Holding seems safe for now; no need to volunteer or swap early. I'll wait and observe Guide choices.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold for now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall advances, three rounds left. Front is Bex. I am last (seat 7), safe unless line shifts. Cole/Ash pact exists; Dara/Fenn pact exists. No one volunteered except Bex in prior round? Log shows only Ash, Bex, Cole, Dara, Eli, Fenn, Hana actions. Bex volunteered but she is front.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Still holding position at the rear. Let's see who steps up to guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Bex is at the front with two wall rounds left; holding keeps me safe in line. Cole is my pact partner, so I should not break it. I'll hold and watch who volunteers.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my seat this round. Let's see who is willing to take the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Front is strong position, holding it pressures others to act or volunteer. Stay put to control pace.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding front. Need a Guide soon or we stall.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Stalling favors me mid-line. Ash holds the pact. Let Bex and Eli risk the front first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding again. The front can prove itself before I move.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintaining pact with Fenn keeps future jury favor; volunteering moves me forward for potential guide selection.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The wall is advancing and I need to survive. The current line is Bex, Eli, Fenn, Dara, Ash, Cole, Hana. Bex is at the front. It's my turn to act. I should volunteer to take the front position to try and gain an advantage or at least survive this round.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold and observe; Dara is my pact partner but no need to act yet. Wall rounds low, so maybe volunteer soon to control position.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Still holding. Watching how the Guide emerges.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Round 4 is a 'hold' round to keep the wall advancing without risking elimination. I must avoid triggering any pact breaks by voting against Ash, Cole, Dara, or Fenn.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Steady as she goes. No moves this round; let's preserve our positions.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli is at front and the wall has one round left; volunteering risks the front step, holding keeps me in line. Pact with Cole stands; I need to avoid being pushed to the front while keeping alliances intact.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my seat. Whoever takes the front, show us your Guide proof first.
Our pact holds. Hold your seat with me this round.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eli and Dara volunteered last round but we're holding steady. With 1 wall round left, hold my safe mid position; no Guide yet, volunteer risky.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding position. Guide still needed before final push.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Wall runs out next round; I must reach front soon. Ash is my pact; volunteering myself is safest for the pact. Jury sees me stepping up, not hiding.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take the front myself this round. Someone elect me Guide-worthy.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain pact with Fenn; avoid risky moves now. Holding preserves position and trust.
Stay aligned

events.name: Eli
events.text: The new round has started and I am at the front of the line. I need to decide whether to volunteer, hold, or swap. Volunteering seems like a good option to secure a safe spot and potentially gain jury favor. Given my current position, volunteering will put me in the first choice

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll take the front. Let's see who the Guide is.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding keeps Dara pact safe; wallRoundsLeft=1 so pushing now risks elimination. Let others volunteer or stall.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll hold and see who steps up before the wall hits.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the back, which is relatively safe. Bex and Cole are ahead of me, but they have pacts that might protect them from volunteering next. I should just hold to maintain my position and avoid drawing attention.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding steady again. Let's keep things simple and see how this round plays out without unnecessary risks.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Round 6 is the final wall; front is Eli, I'm sixth in line. Volunteering risks the front and the pact with Cole is fragile, so holding keeps me safe while others gamble. Need a Guide proof from someone trustworthy before committing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Holding my seat again. Still no Guide proof, so I won't step onto the front blind.
Our pact holds if you hold too. Don't drag me to the front.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Last round before wall hits. Eli at front. I'll volunteer to push forward, aim to get Guide if chaos. Hold position otherwise risky.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Wall closing in. Last chance for true Guide to claim it publicly.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Guide gets guaranteed safety and full knowledge. Eli volunteers too, but seat order resolves ties—wait, Eli is ahead of me. Still, volunteering keeps me in the race for Guide. Ash's pact holds either way.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm contesting the front. Guide should be me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I must keep my pact with Fenn and avoid exposing myself as front; holding preserves both our chances.
Stay together, we survive

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need to volunteer to be the Guide, as it offers the safest position. If I can secure this position, I can potentially control the outcome and ensure my survival.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll volunteer to be the Guide. Let's secure this position and make sure we all get across safely.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Dara is my pact partner, but I need the jury's favor. Eli volunteered for front; I'll hold and watch who claims Guide. No need to break pact yet.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Holding again. Let's see who truly knows the safe sides.
Stick with me; nothing changes.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm at the back of the line. Volunteering now might get me killed by a lying Guide. Holding is safer as I can't control who leads.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Holding position again. Let's see who volunteers to lead before we all step into the unknown.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm the Guide with perfect knowledge: row 1 safe is R. I have no pact to worry about breaking. I should call R to build trust and survive, but I need to think long-term. If I build credibility now, I can betray later for strategic advantage. The jury will see my private thoughts,

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 1: call R. Trust me or fall.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Gus called R for row 1; Eli walks first. Counter-calls are unverified, so a counter-call only adds a public claim. Waiting keeps me out of a possible false-claim fight and preserves my Cole pact.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus called R for row 1, Eli is walker. I'm position 3, safe to counter if confident but I don't know truth. Wait to see others' moves first.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm not Guide and have no proof Gus lies. Countering blind could kill me if the walker heeds me. Wait and watch Eli's step for information.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No proof either way. I wait — Gus owns this call.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Maintain pact with Fenn and avoid risking death; waiting shows no opposition and keeps my standing.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is the Guide and called 'R' for the current row. I am in front. If I trust Gus, I step right. If I don't, I can counter-call left. Since I don't know Gus's reliability or the safe path, and I am in front, it's risky to just trust. A counter-call might mislead others or myself

events.name: Eli
events.text: I will wait to see the safe path.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus called R for row 1; I have no knowledge to contradict him. My pact with Dara is unaffected. I'll wait and let Eli step first, observing result.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'll wait and see.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm Guide with true knowledge R is safe. Counter-calling would expose me as lying if I contradict myself, or signal weakness. Let my true call stand. Anyone countering looks suspicious, not me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Guide Gus called R. No evidence of a lie yet, so I should follow the guide to survive Row 1. Countering risks falling without proof. Staying alive is priority.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I trust the Guide's call for now. We can't afford mistakes on row one.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Gus is the guide. I am Eli and at the front. Gus has called 'R'. My pact is with Cole, but he is not relevant right now. I need to choose a step. The previous actions show everyone waited for the Guide's call. I will follow the Guide's call to R.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll trust the Guide and step R.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 2 safe is L. Eli is front, not my pact partner. I could lie to eliminate threats, but early betrayals look bad to future jury. I'll call true for now, build trust, and save lies for when they matter more.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 2: step left. Trust the Guide.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Row 2 is independent; Gus's L call is unverified and Gus may lie. Eli is front and about to step, so my counter-call would be public. Waiting keeps me out of blame; my pact with Cole stays intact without a counter. No reason to burn information yet.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Gus called L for row 2. Row 1 weak L means safe R, no pattern. Too early to counter without info; wait to see Eli's step.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Gus's calls are unverified; row 1 proved he can be right. I'm second on the line, so Eli tests row 2 before I step. Waiting costs nothing and keeps my pact intact.

events.name: Cole
events.text: No reason to contradict the Guide blind. Waiting again.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Following the Guide keeps me safe and honors my pact with Fenn, preserving allies for jury votes.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I follow the Guide and step left on row two.

events.name: Eli
events.text: The Guide, Gus, called 'L' for row 2. I am Eli and my counter-call is public. I need to decide whether to counter his call, or wait. Since there is no penalty for waiting and I don't want to blindly trust Gus (he might be lying), waiting seems like the safest option. If I wait an

events.name: Eli
events.text: I will wait and see.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Gus called L; row 1 weak was L so R was safe, but each row is independent. I have a pact with Dara, no reason to break. I'll wait and let Eli step based on Guide.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I wait.
Trust the Guide for now; don't counter recklessly.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 2 safe is L. I already called L as Guide. Counter-calling would contradict myself and expose me as a liar to future jury. Let my call stand.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Gus called L. Row 1 was R (weak L). Gus is the guide, so he knows row 2's safe side. I have no counter-evidence to his claim yet. Trusting him aligns with my previous stance and keeps me safe if he tells truth. If he lies, I fall, but others might too. Waiting is safest unless I

events.name: Hana
events.text: I stand by the Guide. Eli steps first; if he survives, we follow L. No need to gamble on unverified counters yet.
If you fall on L, tell us immediately.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara has called L for row 2, and I am the front walker. Hana wants me to step L and report if I fall. Gus is the guide, and the weak pane on row 1 was L, meaning R was safe. However, row 1's pattern doesn't guarantee row 2. Dara's counter-call is for me. I will trust Dara's count

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row 3 safe is L. Eli is front and not my ally. I could lie to eliminate him, but with 8 alive and only 3 needing to survive, early eliminations aren't urgent. Better to build trust as Guide then betray later. I'll call truthfully now.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Row three: step left.

events.name: Ash
